heading: Editing
blocks.intro: Change a page where it is, and see it as visitors will.

blocks.heading: Blocks, not templates
blocks.body: Every page is a list of the site’s own blocks: add them, reorder them and edit them in the page’s preview.

text.p: Edits stay in the draft until someone publishes. A Publish is one commit to the site’s repository.
The header, the footer and any block used on several pages are edited once, in one place.
